Lena P.: Hey all, first day! Thanks for the warm welcome. My desk kit arrived but there was no USB-C cable in the box, one monitor arm screw is loose, and my laptop fails to join CompanyCorp-Enterprise wifi because it keeps asking for a machine certificate I don't have. Opened ticket IT-4942. Any quick tips while IT triages?

Marcus (IT): welcome Lena :wave: Sorry about that. Quick triage: 1) Which monitor arm model (label under base)? 2) Can you try joining the wifi and screenshot the error? 3) Any chance you have a spare USB-C cable at home to test?

Lena P.: Monitor base says "Aerius Dual-Mount v3". I don't have a spare cable. Screenshot: "802.1X authentication failed: client certificate required." I clicked Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll but it errors out halfway with "device profile missing".

Marcus (IT): OK that's the enrollment issue. I can push an enrollment token to your email and resync Device Management. Two action items: I'll overnight a small kit (USB-C 100W cable + replacement arm screw kit + USB-Ethernet dongle) and I'll trigger the enrollment token now. Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1Z777CC30345678901.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4942 updated by Marcus (IT): "Enrollment token sent; overnight kit dispatched."

Lena P.: Thanks! Enrollment email just came, going to follow the steps. One quick question: if enrollment fails again, can we do a remote session? I have a secure work VPN I can use over phone hotspot but prefer wired for the large OS image download.

Marcus (IT): Yep we can remote into the machine after you accept the enrollment consent. If enrollment still fails, DM me and we'll set up a Zoom + screen-sharing session. Also the dongle in the kit will give you a wired fallback until the dock/arm are fully sorted.

Priya S.: welcome Lena! FYI the new-hire checklist is in the #new-hire-ops doc, has step-by-step for enrollment and a short video on the monitor arm install if you want to try tightening the screw yourself.

Lena P.: Awesome, thanks both. I'll try the enrollment now and report back once the kit arrives or if I hit any errors.
